Sections.Section Title: 13.2. Antiplatelet Therapy in Patients Undergoing CABG
Key Points: The preoperative use of aspirin is associated with improved postoperative outcomes in patients undergoing coronary artery bypass grafting.
Aspirin and clopidogrel impact on patients undergoing coronary artery bypass surgery is addressed.
Benefits and risks of using clopidogrel before coronary artery bypass surgery are considered.

Sections.Section Title: 13.3. Beta Blockers and Amiodarone in Patients Undergoing CABG
Key Points: The use of amiodarone and beta blockers is compared in the prevention of postoperative atrial fibrillation.
Stopping beta blockers prior to coronary artery surgery is discussed.
The timing of anticoagulant therapy and impact on outcomes is evaluated.
